title: Fourier Granularity in Dimension Zero
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over the two-element field with dimension zero, and let $f:V\to\{\pm1\}$. Every Walsh Fourier coefficient of the real-valued function $x\mapsto f(x)$ on the dual group of $V$ is an integer multiple of $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$
